blocks.text: Veteran radio disc jockey Diego Bandido, popularly known as Tang Henyo, has died at the age of 47, his radio network Love Radio announced. Love Radio Manila confirmed his passing in a Facebook post on Wednesday, Nov. 25, expressing grief over the loss of one of its beloved radio personalities. “Mabigat ang balitang hatid namin sa inyo, mga Kabisyo. Pumanaw na ang minamahal nating si Diego Bandido, na nakilala at minahal din ng marami bilang si Tang Henyo,” the station said. Love Radio remembered Bandido for his colorful personality, talent, humor, and the memories he created through his voice and radio […]...
